elevator_call_panel.purpose: Wall call panel beside the elevator; the Executive stop is dark until the Night seal

elevator_call_panel_executive_lit.purpose: Same panel with the Executive stop lit (revealed by level 19)

wall_w_plain.purpose: West-wall side plane (the inner face of the wall between the service corridor and the hall). wall_e_plain cannot be mirrored: light is upper-left.

artifact_ada_shift_book.purpose: Small closed book lying on the ledger desk (document close-up uses the shared frame)

gates.visible_change: The security glass slides open to a two-cell walkway; the landing lamp wakes
gates.locked_hint: Closed glass with the exit card pinned beside it: Ada opens it once the practice exit is understood. The break room is the way back.

gates.visible_change: The north stair door slides open onto the ledger room
gates.locked_hint: Sign: repair the lit-route tickets first. The lit route and the way back stay open.

gates.visible_change: The service door opens, giving the ledger a walkable return corridor
gates.locked_hint: Dim stair sign: this corridor returns to the break room once the lit route is repaired.

zones.note: Safe, warmly lit entry. Elevator on the east wall, Ada by the kettle, consoles and the exit card. The lower-left part sits under the keyboard inset and is decor only.
Security vestibule: keypad, two-cell-wide glass gate, clear back exit into the break room.
Lit Caps route B: strip along y 9-10, lane x 12-13 north, door landing x 14-15.
Old route A: lined with inert legacy stations and Pace chevrons; walkable, silent.
Long interior window above; the recall desk sits at its east end.
Northern ledger: one warm lamp against deep indigo. Doors west (north stair) and east (service).
Service corridor back to the break room and Mira; gains warm light and silhouettes at 19.

interactions.label: Ada by the kettle (greeting, practice-exit explanation)
Noticeboard: operations cards and the exit card
Security glass (opens when practice is understood)
Ada at the start of the lit route (practice check-in)
Lit route start (walk north along the Caps route)
Recall desk under the long window
Legacy station card (why the old route is silent)
Ada at the north stair door
North stair door (opens when Ada confirms the lit route)
Service door to the corridor back to the break room
Ledger noticeboard: check-in and operations cards
Ada's shift book on the ledger desk
Mira at the corridor mouth (Lights-Out Delivery)

npcs.patrol_clock: walk-alongside: after the glass opens Ada walks this path once to the nook, passes through the open glass and waits at the landing (cells_by_state nightshift-17); not a loop
npcs.note: Positions: break room (start), lit-route landing after 17, north stair door during the end of 18 (move_npc "stair"), back at the kettle after 19. Lantern rim is baked into the sprite.

Coral strap visible in the dark. Wears patches 1..K for the routes cleared so far (mira-patches atlas state K). Offers Lights-Out Delivery after 18; before that she says to finish the lit route first.

Absent before 18. After the tickets are repaired a coworker silhouette appears inside the ledger room, seen through the glass partitions (silhouette atlas, bgworker_a-atlas-silhouette-lit); after 19 the sprite walks independently.

npcs.patrol_clock: independent (random 0-999 ms offset, per bgworker_a sync rules after relax)
npcs.note: Absent before 19. Warm service corridor gains moving coworkers.
Absent before 19; walks the corridor in the opposite phase to worker_c1.

main.label: Elevator arrival, across the break room to the vestibule nook (the glass is still closed)
Through the open glass, along the lit Caps route B to the north stair door landing
Through the open stair door to the ledger terminal (review)

backtrack.label: Ledger east door, service corridor south, into the break room beside Mira. Never crosses the silent stations; warm and lit after 19.
Back down the lit route, through the vestibule, to the consoles and the elevator

spawns.when: arriving by the Night Shift elevator stop
returning through the service corridor after nightshift-18

notes: Collision is for the initial state: the elevator door, the vestibule gate (2 of 4 cells open later) and both ledger doors are closed.
Cells x 0-9, y 15-19 (south-west corner) are a closed storage block of shelves; the keyboard inset covers that corner at x4, so nothing playable is placed there.
